manifest.title: Order-invariant cluster first-order logic on finite graphs of bounded degree

inputs.abstract:
For a fixed finite unary vocabulary and a degree bound, the target is elimination
of the auxiliary linear order from every order-invariant cluster first-order
sentence. The graph domain may be empty. The concepts give the thesis's
cluster syntax, ordinary order-free syntax, their satisfaction relation,
and recursive comparison of outer contexts. The submission separates the
ordered comparison lemma, the construction of orders from finitely many
first-order tests, and the final finite disjunction. The proof-dependency
information in the local build identifies which statements have been discharged.

concepts.title: Context labels in the intervals of an ordered partition
concepts.description:
The map from vertices to block indices is monotone. Each nonempty block has
a first and a last vertex. A block label contributes once whenever any vertex
of that block meets the gap. The internal interval and both exterior intervals
are stated pointwise, so identical labels on different blocks are allowed.
concepts.sourceText:
import Mathlib.Order.Monotone.Basic

/-!
---
title: Context labels in the intervals of an ordered partition
type: lemma
---
The map from vertices to block indices is monotone. Each nonempty block has
a first and a last vertex. A block label contributes once whenever any vertex
of that block meets the gap. The internal interval and both exterior intervals
are stated pointwise, so identical labels on different blocks are allowed.
-/
namespace Lax977378.Blocks

structure Partition (V I : Type) [LinearOrder V] [LinearOrder I] where
  block : V → I
  monotone : Monotone block
  first : I → V
  last : I → V
  first_mem : ∀ i, block (first i) = i
  last_mem : ∀ i, block (last i) = i
  first_le : ∀ v, first (block v) ≤ v
  le_last : ∀ v, v ≤ last (block v)

axiom interval {V I L : Type} [LinearOrder V] [LinearOrder I] (P : Partition V I)
    (label : I → L) (a b : V) (hab : P.block a < P.block b) (l : L) :
    (∃ x, a < x ∧ x < b ∧ label (P.block x) = l) ↔
    (∃ i, P.block a < i ∧ i < P.block b ∧ label i = l) ∨
    (a ≠ P.last (P.block a) ∧ label (P.block a) = l) ∨
    (b ≠ P.first (P.block b) ∧ label (P.block b) = l)

axiom outerIntervals {V I L : Type} [LinearOrder V] [LinearOrder I] (P : Partition V I)
    (label : I → L) (a : V) (l : L) :
    ((∃ x, x < a ∧ label (P.block x) = l) ↔
      (∃ i, i < P.block a ∧ label i = l) ∨
      (a ≠ P.first (P.block a) ∧ label (P.block a) = l)) ∧
    ((∃ x, a < x ∧ label (P.block x) = l) ↔
      (∃ i, P.block a < i ∧ label i = l) ∨
      (a ≠ P.last (P.block a) ∧ label (P.block a) = l))

end Lax977378.Blocks

        (And (Ne a (P.first (P.block a))) (Eq (label (P.block a)) l))))
    (Iff (Exists fun x => And (inst.lt a x) (Eq (label (P.block x)) l))
      (Or (Exists fun i => And (inst_1.lt (P.block a) i) (Eq (label i) l))
        (And (Ne a (P.last (P.block a))) (Eq (label (P.block a)) l))))

concepts.title: Comparison of different representatives of a recursive call
concepts.description:
Data read at each vertex can be represented by labels. Two source vertices
matching the same target call can be compared by composing their local
correspondences. A match at the full rank gives matches at every lower rank
at the same centre.
concepts.sourceText:
import Lax977378.LocalCalls

/-!
---
title: Comparison of different representatives of a recursive call
type: lemma
---
Data read at each vertex can be represented by labels. Two source vertices
matching the same target call can be compared by composing their local
correspondences. A match at the full rank gives matches at every lower rank
at the same centre.
-/
namespace Lax977378.CallAgreement
open Lax977378.Logic Lax977378.LocalCalls

def agrees {c} (A B : Graph c)
    (ra ea : Nat → Fin A.size → Nat) (rb eb : Nat → Fin B.size → Nat) :=
  Calls A B (fun j x y => ra j x = rb j y) (fun j x y => ea j x = eb j y)

axiom compareReps {c} (A B : Graph c) (ra ea : Nat → Fin A.size → Nat)
    (rb eb : Nat → Fin B.size → Nat) (i : Nat) (x u : Fin A.size) (y : Fin B.size)
    (hx : agrees A B ra ea rb eb i x y) (hu : agrees A B ra ea rb eb i u y) :
    agrees A A ra ea ra ea i x u

axiom lowerRanks {c} (A B : Graph c) (ra ea : Nat → Fin A.size → Nat)
    (rb eb : Nat → Fin B.size → Nat) (i j : Nat) (hj : j ≤ i) (x y)
    (h : agrees A B ra ea rb eb i x y) : agrees A B ra ea rb eb j x y

end Lax977378.CallAgreement

concepts.title: Finite catalogue of bounded-degree neighbourhoods
concepts.description:
For a fixed vocabulary, degree and radius there is a finite list of pointed
graphs covering all rooted neighbourhoods. Occurrence means an isomorphism
onto the entire induced ball, including its boundary. Numberings of a ball
can give repeated entries; the catalogue makes no uniqueness claim.

concepts.title: Finite selection of tests with a replayable final table
concepts.description:
Once the unordered data and the final labels range over finite sets, one can
retain exactly the pairs for which every passing graph admits a suitable order.
It suffices to exhibit one such pair for each individual bounded-degree graph.
Intermediate tables may be used to prove replay without encoding them in FO.
concepts.sourceText:
import Lax977378.Replay
import Lax977378.FiniteTests

/-!
---
title: Finite selection of tests with a replayable final table
type: lemma
---
Once the unordered data and the final labels range over finite sets, one can
retain exactly the pairs for which every passing graph admits a suitable order.
It suffices to exhibit one such pair for each individual bounded-degree graph.
Intermediate tables may be used to prove replay without encoding them in FO.
-/
namespace Lax977378.CheckedEntries
open Lax977378.Logic Lax977378.OuterContexts Lax977378.RecordTests Lax977378.Collapse

axiom selectEntries {c d K n N} (types : Fin n → Pointed c) (r R cap U : Nat)
    (lab : (G : Graph c) → G.Bounded d → LinearOrder (Fin G.size) → Fin G.size → Fin N)
    (sound : ∀ A B ha hb a b x y, lab A ha a x = lab B hb b y → same A B a b K x y)
    (witness : ∀ A : Graph c, A.Bounded d →
      ∃ (D : TestData c) (S : Finset (Fin N)) (v : Fin n → Fin (cap+1)) (t : Nat),
        D.radius = r ∧ D.windowRadius = R ∧ D.cap = cap ∧ D.windowGraph.size ≤ U ∧
        D.counts = List.ofFn (fun j => (types j,(v j).val)) ∧
        D.frequent = ((List.finRange n).filter (fun j => t ≤ (v j).val)).map types ∧
        Passes D A ∧ ∀ (B : Graph c) (hb : B.Bounded d), Passes D B →
          ∃ b, Finset.univ.image (lab B hb b) = S) :
    ∃ tests : List (Record (c := c) d K), ∀ G, G.Bounded d → ∃ e ∈ tests, Unordered G e.test

end Lax977378.CheckedEntries

statements.signature:
selectEntries : ∀ {c d K n N : Nat} (types : Fin n → Lax977378.RecordTests.Pointed c) (r R cap U : Nat)
  (lab : (G : Lax977378.Logic.Graph c) → G.Bounded d → LinearOrder (Fin G.size) → Fin G.size → Fin N),
  (∀ (A B : Lax977378.Logic.Graph c) (ha : A.Bounded d) (hb : B.Bounded d) (a : LinearOrder (Fin A.size))
      (b : LinearOrder (Fin B.size)) (x : Fin A.size) (y : Fin B.size),
      Eq (lab A ha a x) (lab B hb b y) → Lax977378.OuterContexts.same A B a b K x y) →
    (∀ (A : Lax977378.Logic.Graph c),
        A.Bounded d →
          Exists fun D =>
            Exists fun S =>
              Exists fun v =>
                Exists fun t =>
                  And (Eq D.radius r)
                    (And (Eq D.windowRadius R)
                      (And (Eq D.cap cap)
                        (And (instLENat.le D.windowGraph.size U)
                          (And (Eq D.counts (List.ofFn fun j => { fst := types j, snd := (v j).val }))
                            (And
                              (Eq D.frequent
                                (List.map types
                                  (List.filter (fun j => Decidable.decide (instLENat.le t (v j).val))
                                    (List.finRange n))))
                              (And (Lax977378.RecordTests.Passes D A)
                                (∀ (B : Lax977378.Logic.Graph c) (hb : B.Bounded d),
                                  Lax977378.RecordTests.Passes D B →
                                    Exists fun b => Eq (Finset.image (lab B hb b) Finset.univ) S)))))))) →
      Exists fun tests =>
        ∀ (G : Lax977378.Logic.Graph c),
          G.Bounded d → Exists fun e => And (List.instMembership.mem tests e) (Lax977378.Logic.Unordered G e.test)

concepts.title: Elimination of order from invariant cluster sentences
concepts.description:
The main statement quantifies over every class of finite coloured graphs
of degree at most $d$. The two intermediate statements are the ordered
comparison lemma and the finite-record order construction in pairwise form.
A record chooses an order using just the record and the individual graph.
The same record must work uniformly over all graphs passing its test.
concepts.sourceText:
import Lax977378.OuterContexts

/-!
---
title: Elimination of order from invariant cluster sentences
type: theorem
---
The main statement quantifies over every class of finite coloured graphs
of degree at most $d$. The two intermediate statements are the ordered
comparison lemma and the finite-record order construction in pairwise form.
A record chooses an order using just the record and the individual graph.
The same record must work uniformly over all graphs passing its test.
-/
namespace Lax977378.Collapse

open Lax977378.Logic Lax977378.OuterContexts

axiom comparison {c : Nat} (K : Nat) (A B : Graph c)
    (a : LinearOrder (Fin A.size)) (b : LinearOrder (Fin B.size))
    (agree : spectrumAgrees A B a b K) (f : Formula c) (legal : Legal [] f)
    (bound : rank f ≤ K+1) : Holds A a f ↔ Holds B b f

structure Record {c : Nat} (d K : Nat) where
  test : Formula c
  plain : Plain [] test
  order : (G : Graph c) → LinearOrder (Fin G.size)
  agree : ∀ A B, A.Bounded d → B.Bounded d → Unordered A test → Unordered B test →
    spectrumAgrees A B (order A) (order B) K

axiom records (c d K : Nat) : ∃ tests : List (Record (c := c) d K),
  ∀ G, G.Bounded d → ∃ e ∈ tests, Unordered G e.test

axiom relativeCollapse {c d : Nat} (C : Graph c → Prop) (bounded : ∀ G, C G → G.Bounded d)
    (f : Formula c) (legal : Legal [] f) (inv : InvariantOn C f) :
    ∃ φ : Formula c, Plain [] φ ∧ ∀ G, C G → ∀ o, Holds G o f ↔ Unordered G φ

/-- The thesis convention requires order invariance on every finite coloured graph. -/
axiom collapse {c d : Nat} (C : Graph c → Prop) (bounded : ∀ G, C G → G.Bounded d)
    (f : Formula c) (legal : Legal [] f)
    (inv : ∀ G : Graph c, ∀ a b, Holds G a f ↔ Holds G b f) :
    ∃ φ : Formula c, Plain [] φ ∧ ∀ G, C G → ∀ o, Holds G o f ↔ Unordered G φ

end Lax977378.Collapse

      Lax977378.Logic.Legal List.nil f →
        (∀ (G : Lax977378.Logic.Graph c) (a b : LinearOrder (Fin G.size)),

concepts.title: Bounded source run from a coloured graph and its rare vertices
concepts.description:
Every rare vertex starts in a singleton. Other vertices start together
exactly when their unary predicates and auxiliary colour agree. A proper
colouring of the graph power makes the initial rows distinct on each
inspected ball. The whole history can then be constructed up to rank K.
concepts.sourceText:
import Lax977378.SourceRun
import Lax977378.Planting

/-!
---
title: Bounded source run from a coloured graph and its rare vertices
type: lemma
---
Every rare vertex starts in a singleton. Other vertices start together
exactly when their unary predicates and auxiliary colour agree. A proper
colouring of the graph power makes the initial rows distinct on each
inspected ball. The whole history can then be constructed up to rank K.
-/
namespace Lax977378.ColouredRun
open Lax977378.Logic Lax977378.OuterContexts Lax977378.Planting Lax977378.SourceRun Lax977378.Stage

axiom colouredRun (c d K : Nat) : ∃ N : Nat → Nat, ∀ (G : Graph c), G.Bounded d →
    ∀ (q : Nat) (κ : Fin G.size → Fin q), ProperOn G (K+K) Finset.univ κ →
    ∀ Z : Finset (Fin G.size), ∃ I L : Layer G,
      I.exceptions = Z ∧
      (∀ x y, I.row x = I.row y ↔ x = y ∨
        x ∉ Z ∧ y ∉ Z ∧ κ x = κ y ∧ ∀ p, G.pred p x ↔ G.pred p y) ∧
      History G I K L ∧ Stable G K L.row ∧ Function.Surjective L.row ∧
      L.n ≤ limit d N (Z.card + 2^c*q) K ∧ L.exceptions.card ≤ limit d N (Z.card + 2^c*q) K

end Lax977378.ColouredRun

statements.signature:
colouredRun : ∀ (c d K : Nat),
  Exists fun N =>
    ∀ (G : Lax977378.Logic.Graph c),
      G.Bounded d →
        ∀ (q : Nat) (κ : Fin G.size → Fin q),
          Lax977378.Planting.ProperOn G (instHAdd.hAdd K K) Finset.univ κ →
            ∀ (Z : Finset (Fin G.size)),
              Exists fun I =>
                Exists fun L =>
                  And (Eq I.exceptions Z)
                    (And
                      (∀ (x y : Fin G.size),
                        Iff (Eq (I.row x) (I.row y))
                          (Or (Eq x y)
                            (And (Not (SetLike.instMembership.mem Z x))
                              (And (Not (SetLike.instMembership.mem Z y))
                                (And (Eq (κ x) (κ y)) (∀ (p : Fin c), Iff (G.pred p x) (G.pred p y)))))))
                      (And (Lax977378.SourceRun.History G I K L)
                        (And (Lax977378.Stage.Stable G K L.row)
                          (And (Function.Surjective L.row)
                            (And
                              (instLENat.le L.n
                                (Lax977378.SourceRun.limit d N
                                  (instHAdd.hAdd Z.card (instHMul.hMul (instHPow.hPow 2 c) q)) K))
                              (instLENat.le L.exceptions.card
                                (Lax977378.SourceRun.limit d N
                                  (instHAdd.hAdd Z.card (instHMul.hMul (instHPow.hPow 2 c) q)) K)))))))

concepts.title: The list of coloured frequent neighbourhood types
concepts.description:
Enumerate every injective palette assignment to a frequent uncoloured pattern.
In a proper colouring of the graph power this list covers every nonrare
vertex. Its length is bounded before the frequency vector is chosen.
concepts.sourceText:
import Lax977378.Reservoir

/-!
---
title: The list of coloured frequent neighbourhood types
type: lemma
---
Enumerate every injective palette assignment to a frequent uncoloured pattern.
In a proper colouring of the graph power this list covers every nonrare
vertex. Its length is bounded before the frequency vector is chosen.
-/
namespace Lax977378.ColouredTypes
open Lax977378.Logic Lax977378.Planting Lax977378.RecordTests Lax977378.CountParameters

axiom colouredTypes {c n} (types : Fin n → Pointed c) (q : Nat) : ∃ H : Nat,
    ∀ (v : Fin n → Nat) (t : Nat), ∃ seeds : List (Request c q), seeds.length ≤ H ∧
      (∀ s ∈ seeds, ∃ j, t ≤ v j ∧ s.type = types j) ∧
      ∀ (G : Graph c) (r : Nat) (κ : Fin G.size → Fin q),
        ProperOn G (r+r) Finset.univ κ → ∀ x, x ∉ rareSet types r G v t →
          ∃ s ∈ seeds, Realised s G r κ x

end Lax977378.ColouredTypes

statements.signature:
colouredTypes : ∀ {c n : Nat} (types : Fin n → Lax977378.RecordTests.Pointed c) (q : Nat),
  Exists fun H =>
    ∀ (v : Fin n → Nat) (t : Nat),
      Exists fun seeds =>
        And (instLENat.le seeds.length H)
          (And
            (∀ (s : Lax977378.Planting.Request c q),
              List.instMembership.mem seeds s → Exists fun j => And (instLENat.le t (v j)) (Eq s.type (types j)))
            (∀ (G : Lax977378.Logic.Graph c) (r : Nat) (κ : Fin G.size → Fin q),
              Lax977378.Planting.ProperOn G (instHAdd.hAdd r r) Finset.univ κ →
                ∀ (x : Fin G.size),
                  Not (SetLike.instMembership.mem (Lax977378.CountParameters.rareSet types r G v t) x) →
                    Exists fun s => And (List.instMembership.mem seeds s) (Lax977378.Planting.Realised s G r κ x)))

concepts.title: A common palette of frequent coloured types determined by the count vector
concepts.description:
Fix a nondecreasing allowance for exceptions as a function of the number of
rare vertices. Thresholds and the catalogue of coloured requests then depend
only on the capped vector. Each graph with this vector admits a proper
colouring extending any permitted precolouring. Every request still occurs
outside any subsequently chosen set within the allowance.
concepts.sourceText:
import Lax977378.ColouredTypes

/-!
---
title: A common palette of frequent coloured types determined by the count vector
type: lemma
---
Fix a nondecreasing allowance for exceptions as a function of the number of
rare vertices. Thresholds and the catalogue of coloured requests then depend
only on the capped vector. Each graph with this vector admits a proper
colouring extending any permitted precolouring. Every request still occurs
outside any subsequently chosen set within the allowance.
-/
namespace Lax977378.CommonPalette
open Lax977378.Logic Lax977378.Planting Lax977378.RecordTests Lax977378.CountParameters

axiom uniform (c d r q : Nat) (palette : (d+1)^(r+r) ≤ q)
    (g : Nat → Nat) (mono : Monotone g) :
    ∃ n : Nat, ∃ types : Fin n → Pointed c, ∃ cap : Nat,
    ∃ threshold : (Fin n → Nat) → Nat, ∃ seeds : (Fin n → Nat) → List (Request c q),
    ∀ (G : Graph c), G.Bounded d →
      let v := fun j => min cap (locations (types j) r G).card
      let t := threshold v
      let Z := rareSet types r G v t
      0 < t ∧ t ≤ cap ∧ Z.card ≤ n*(cap-1) ∧
      (∀ κ, ProperOn G (r+r) Finset.univ κ → ∀ x ∉ Z,
        ∃ s ∈ seeds v, Realised s G r κ x) ∧
      ∀ (P : Finset (Fin G.size)) (colour : Fin G.size → Fin q),
        P.card ≤ g Z.card → ProperOn G (r+r) P colour →
        ∃ k, (∀ u ∈ P, k u = colour u) ∧ ProperOn G (r+r) Finset.univ k ∧
          ∀ s ∈ seeds v, ∀ M : Finset (Fin G.size), M.card ≤ g Z.card →
            ∃ x ∉ M, Realised s G r k x

end Lax977378.CommonPalette

statements.signature:
uniform : ∀ (c d r q : Nat),
  instLENat.le (instHPow.hPow (instHAdd.hAdd d 1) (instHAdd.hAdd r r)) q →
    ∀ (g : Nat → Nat),
      Monotone g →
        Exists fun n =>
          Exists fun types =>
            Exists fun cap =>
              Exists fun threshold =>
                Exists fun seeds =>
                  ∀ (G : Lax977378.Logic.Graph c),
                    G.Bounded d →
                      let v := fun j => instMinNat.min cap (Lax977378.CountParameters.locations (types j) r G).card;
                      let t := threshold v;
                      let Z := Lax977378.CountParameters.rareSet types r G v t;
                      And (instLTNat.lt 0 t)
                        (And (instLENat.le t cap)
                          (And (instLENat.le Z.card (instHMul.hMul n (instHSub.hSub cap 1)))
                            (And
                              (∀ (κ : Fin G.size → Fin q),
                                Lax977378.Planting.ProperOn G (instHAdd.hAdd r r) Finset.univ κ →
                                  ∀ (x : Fin G.size),

concepts.title: The threshold and rare set determined by a truncated count vector
concepts.description:
The vector indexed by the non-repeating catalogue determines the least eligible
threshold and the exact number of rare vertices. These are uniform parameters
for every graph with the given vector. Saturated entries suffice for each
frequent type, while the low entries still give exact cardinalities.

import Lax977378.Types
import Lax977378.Threshold

/-!
---
title: The threshold and rare set determined by a truncated count vector
type: lemma
---
The vector indexed by the non-repeating catalogue determines the least eligible
threshold and the exact number of rare vertices. These are uniform parameters
for every graph with the given vector. Saturated entries suffice for each
frequent type, while the low entries still give exact cardinalities.
-/
namespace Lax977378.CountParameters
open Lax977378.Logic Lax977378.RecordTests

noncomputable def locations {c} (t : Pointed c) (r : Nat) (G : Graph c) : Finset (Fin G.size) := by
  classical exact Finset.univ.filter (Occurs t r G)

noncomputable def rareSet {c n} (types : Fin n → Pointed c) (r : Nat) (G : Graph c)
    (v : Fin n → Nat) (t : Nat) : Finset (Fin G.size) := by
  classical exact Finset.univ.filter (fun x => ¬ ∃ j, t ≤ v j ∧ Occurs (types j) r G x)

def Eligible {n} (h : Nat → Nat) (v : Fin n → Nat) (cap t : Nat) : Prop :=
  0 < t ∧ t ≤ cap ∧ h (Threshold.rareTotal t (List.ofFn v)) ≤ t

axiom countTestValue {c} (a : Pointed c) (r cap k : Nat) (G : Graph c) :
    (k ≤ cap ∧ AtLeast a r k G ∧ (k < cap → ¬ AtLeast a r (k+1) G)) ↔
      k = min cap (locations a r G).card

axiom fixedParameters {c d r n} (types : Fin n → Pointed c)
    (cover : ∀ G : Graph c, G.Bounded d → ∀ x, ∃! j, Occurs (types j) r G x)
    (h : Nat → Nat) (mono : Monotone h) :
    ∃ cap : Nat, ∃ threshold : (Fin n → Nat) → Nat,
∀ (G : Graph c), G.Bounded d →
        let counts := fun j => (locations (types j) r G).card
        let v := fun j => min cap (counts j)
        let t := threshold v
        Eligible h v cap t ∧ (∀ u, Eligible h v cap u → t ≤ u) ∧
        (∀ j, t ≤ v j ↔ t ≤ counts j) ∧
        (rareSet types r G v t).card = Threshold.rareTotal t (List.ofFn v) ∧
        (rareSet types r G v t).card ≤ n * (cap-1)

axiom parameters (c d r : Nat) (h : Nat → Nat) (mono : Monotone h) :
    ∃ n : Nat, ∃ types : Fin n → Pointed c, ∃ cap : Nat,
    ∃ threshold : (Fin n → Nat) → Nat,
      (∀ G : Graph c, G.Bounded d → ∀ x, ∃! j, Occurs (types j) r G x) ∧
      ∀ (G : Graph c), G.Bounded d →
        let counts := fun j => (locations (types j) r G).card
        let v := fun j => min cap (counts j)
        let t := threshold v
        Eligible h v cap t ∧ (∀ u, Eligible h v cap u → t ≤ u) ∧
        (∀ j, t ≤ v j ↔ t ≤ counts j) ∧
        (rareSet types r G v t).card = Threshold.rareTotal t (List.ofFn v) ∧
        (rareSet types r G v t).card ≤ n * (cap-1)

end Lax977378.CountParameters

  Iff
    (And (instLENat.le k cap)
      (And (Lax977378.RecordTests.AtLeast a r k G)
        (instLTNat.lt k cap → Not (Lax977378.RecordTests.AtLeast a r (instHAdd.hAdd k 1) G))))
    (Eq k (instMinNat.min cap (Lax977378.CountParameters.locations a r G).card))

  (∀ (G : Lax977378.Logic.Graph c),
      G.Bounded d → ∀ (x : Fin G.size), ExistsUnique fun j => Lax977378.RecordTests.Occurs (types j) r G x) →
    ∀ (h : Nat → Nat),
      Monotone h →
        Exists fun cap =>
          Exists fun threshold =>
            ∀ (G : Lax977378.Logic.Graph c),
              G.Bounded d →
                let counts := fun j => (Lax977378.CountParameters.locations (types j) r G).card;
                let v := fun j => instMinNat.min cap (counts j);
                let t := threshold v;
                And (Lax977378.CountParameters.Eligible h v cap t)
                  (And (∀ (u : Nat), Lax977378.CountParameters.Eligible h v cap u → instLENat.le t u)
                    (And (∀ (j : Fin n), Iff (instLENat.le t (v j)) (instLENat.le t (counts j)))
                      (And
                        (Eq (Lax977378.CountParameters.rareSet types r G v t).card
                          (Lax977378.Threshold.rareTotal t (List.ofFn v)))
                        (instLENat.le (Lax977378.CountParameters.rareSet types r G v t).card
                          (instHMul.hMul n (instHSub.hSub cap 1))))))

parameters : ∀ (c d r : Nat) (h : Nat → Nat),
  Monotone h →
    Exists fun n =>
      Exists fun types =>
        Exists fun cap =>
          Exists fun threshold =>
            And
              (∀ (G : Lax977378.Logic.Graph c),
                G.Bounded d → ∀ (x : Fin G.size), ExistsUnique fun j => Lax977378.RecordTests.Occurs (types j) r G x)
              (∀ (G : Lax977378.Logic.Graph c),
                G.Bounded d →
                  let counts := fun j => (Lax977378.CountParameters.locations (types j) r G).card;
                  let v := fun j => instMinNat.min cap (counts j);
                  let t := threshold v;
                  And (Lax977378.CountParameters.Eligible h v cap t)
                    (And (∀ (u : Nat), Lax977378.CountParameters.Eligible h v cap u → instLENat.le t u)
                      (And (∀ (j : Fin n), Iff (instLENat.le t (v j)) (instLENat.le t (counts j)))
                        (And
                          (Eq (Lax977378.CountParameters.rareSet types r G v t).card
                            (Lax977378.Threshold.rareTotal t (List.ofFn v)))
                          (instLENat.le (Lax977378.CountParameters.rareSet types r G v t).card
                            (instHMul.hMul n (instHSub.hSub cap 1)))))))

concepts.title: Independent order from coverage of full-rank local calls
concepts.description:
Choose one source representative per target vertex from the full-rank local
comparisons. Reverse coverage makes every source row appear in the target,
even though the representative chosen for a target need not be the source
vertex that witnessed reverse coverage. Named endpoints have unique fibres.

import Lax977378.LocalNames

/-!
---
title: Independent order from coverage of full-rank local calls
type: lemma
---
Choose one source representative per target vertex from the full-rank local
comparisons. Reverse coverage makes every source row appear in the target,
even though the representative chosen for a target need not be the source
vertex that witnessed reverse coverage. Named endpoints have unique fibres.
-/
namespace Lax977378.CoverReplay
open Lax977378.Logic Lax977378.OuterContexts Lax977378.Blocks Lax977378.CallAgreement

axiom orderFromCover {c d K} (A B : Graph c) (ha : A.Bounded d) (hb : B.Bounded d)
    (a : LinearOrder (Fin A.size)) (n : Nat → Nat)
    (P : (j : Nat) → @Partition (Fin A.size) (Fin (n j)) a inferInstance)
    (ra ea : Nat → Fin A.size → Nat) (rb eb : Nat → Fin B.size → Nat)
    (fwd : ∀ x, ∃ z, agrees A B ra ea rb eb K x z)
    (back : ∀ z, ∃ x, agrees A B ra ea rb eb K x z)
    (pred : ∀ x z, ra 0 x = rb 0 z → ∀ p, A.pred p x ↔ B.pred p z)
    (base : ∀ x y, ra 0 x = ra 0 y → (P 0).block x = (P 0).block y)
    (child : ∀ j < K, ∀ x y, ra (j+1) x = ra (j+1) y → (P j).block x = (P j).block y →
      same A A a a (j+1) x y → (P (j+1)).block x = (P (j+1)).block y)
    (hom : ∀ j ≤ K, ∀ x y, (P j).block x = (P j).block y → same A A a a j x y)
    (parent : ∀ j < K, ∀ x y, (P (j+1)).block x = (P (j+1)).block y → (P j).block x = (P j).block y)
    (ends : ∀ j < K, ∀ t, ∀ e ∈ [(P j).first t,(P j).last t],
      (∀ x, (P (j+1)).block x = (P (j+1)).block e → x = e) ∧
      (∀ x, ra K x = ra K e → x = e) ∧ ∀ z w, rb K z = ra K e → rb K w = ra K e → z = w)
    (separated : ∀ j < K, ∀ x, Function.Injective (fun v : Ball A (j+1) x => (P j).block v.val))
    (roles : ∀ j < K, ∀ x y, ea (j+1) x = ea (j+1) y →
      (x = (P j).first ((P j).block x) ↔ y = (P j).first ((P j).block y)) ∧
      (x = (P j).last ((P j).block x) ↔ y = (P j).last ((P j).block y))) :
    ∃ b, spectrumAgrees A B a b K

end Lax977378.CoverReplay

                    instLTNat.lt j K →
                      ∀ (x y : Fin A.size),
                        Eq (ra (instHAdd.hAdd j 1) x) (ra (instHAdd.hAdd j 1) y) →
                          Eq ((P j).block x) ((P j).block y) →

concepts.title: Choosing and realising endpoints in the ordinary blocks
concepts.description:
Outside the exceptional set, all planted centres with the same coloured type
belong to the same block whenever the calculation without tags gives its name.
Two of these centres survive if the multiplicity exceeds the exceptional bound
by two. Every simultaneous choice of legal endpoint pairs is realised by an
order on the individual graph.
concepts.sourceText:
import Mathlib.Data.Finset.Sort
import Lax977378.Blocks
import Mathlib.Data.Finset.Card

/-!
---
title: Choosing and realising endpoints in the ordinary blocks
type: lemma
---
Outside the exceptional set, all planted centres with the same coloured type
belong to the same block whenever the calculation without tags gives its name.
Two of these centres survive if the multiplicity exceeds the exceptional bound
by two. Every simultaneous choice of legal endpoint pairs is realised by an
order on the individual graph.
-/
namespace Lax977378.Endpoints
open Lax977378.Blocks

axiom twoCentres {V I : Type} [DecidableEq V] (block : V → I) (i : I)
    (Γ S : Finset V) (enough : Γ.card + 2 ≤ S.card)
    (ordinary : ∀ x ∈ S, x ∉ Γ → block x = i) :
    ∃ u ∈ S, ∃ v ∈ S, u ∉ Γ ∧ v ∉ Γ ∧ u ≠ v ∧ block u = i ∧ block v = i

axiom admissible {n m : Nat} (block : Fin n → Fin m) (first last : Fin m → Fin n)
    (hf : ∀ i, block (first i) = i) (hl : ∀ i, block (last i) = i)
    (singleton : ∀ i, first i = last i → ∀ x, block x = i → x = first i) :
    ∃ a : LinearOrder (Fin n), ∃ P : @Partition (Fin n) (Fin m) a inferInstance,
      P.block = block ∧ P.first = first ∧ P.last = last

end Lax977378.Endpoints

  (∀ (i : Fin m), Eq (block (first i)) i) →
    (∀ (i : Fin m), Eq (block (last i)) i) →
      (∀ (i : Fin m), Eq (first i) (last i) → ∀ (x : Fin n), Eq (block x) i → Eq x (first i)) →
        Exists fun a => Exists fun P => And (Eq P.block block) (And (Eq P.first first) (Eq P.last last))

twoCentres : ∀ {V I : Type} [DecidableEq V] (block : V → I) (i : I) (Γ S : Finset V),
  instLENat.le (instHAdd.hAdd Γ.card 2) S.card →
    (∀ (x : V), SetLike.instMembership.mem S x → Not (SetLike.instMembership.mem Γ x) → Eq (block x) i) →
      Exists fun u =>
        And (SetLike.instMembership.mem S u)
          (Exists fun v =>
            And (SetLike.instMembership.mem S v)
              (And (Not (SetLike.instMembership.mem Γ u))
                (And (Not (SetLike.instMembership.mem Γ v)) (And (Ne u v) (And (Eq (block u) i) (Eq (block v) i))))))

concepts.title: Extracting the unordered test from an exceptional set
concepts.description:
Take the actual truncated counts and an exceptional set containing the rare
vertices. The graph supplies a bounded induced window, with the exceptional
and rare vertices named, and satisfies the resulting unordered record test.
concepts.sourceText:
import Lax977378.CountParameters

/-!
---
title: Extracting the unordered test from an exceptional set
type: lemma
---
Take the actual truncated counts and an exceptional set containing the rare
vertices. The graph supplies a bounded induced window, with the exceptional
and rare vertices named, and satisfies the resulting unordered record test.
-/
namespace Lax977378.Extraction
open Lax977378.Logic Lax977378.RecordTests Lax977378.CountParameters

axiom extract {c d n} (G : Graph c) (hd : G.Bounded d) (r R cap t : Nat)
    (types : Fin n → Pointed c) (M : Finset (Fin G.size))
    (v : Fin n → Nat) (counts : ∀ j, v j = min cap (locations (types j) r G).card)
    (contains : rareSet types r G v t ⊆ M) :
    ∃ D : TestData c, D.radius = r ∧ D.windowRadius = R ∧ D.cap = cap ∧
      D.counts = List.ofFn (fun j => (types j,v j)) ∧
      D.frequent = ((List.finRange n).filter (fun j => t ≤ v j)).map types ∧
      D.windowGraph.size ≤ M.card * (d+1)^R ∧
      (∃ y, Window D.windowGraph G R D.marked y ∧ D.marked.image y = M ∧
        D.rare.image y = rareSet types r G v t) ∧ Passes D G ∧
      ∃ f, Plain [] f ∧ Unordered G f ∧ ∀ B, Unordered B f ↔ Passes D B

end Lax977378.Extraction

statements.signature:
extract : ∀ {c d n : Nat} (G : Lax977378.Logic.Graph c),
  G.Bounded d →
    ∀ (r R cap t : Nat) (types : Fin n → Lax977378.RecordTests.Pointed c) (M : Finset (Fin G.size)) (v : Fin n → Nat),
      (∀ (j : Fin n), Eq (v j) (instMinNat.min cap (Lax977378.CountParameters.locations (types j) r G).card)) →
        Finset.instPartialOrder.le (Lax977378.CountParameters.rareSet types r G v t) M →
          Exists fun D =>
            And (Eq D.radius r)
              (And (Eq D.windowRadius R)
                (And (Eq D.cap cap)
                  (And (Eq D.counts (List.ofFn fun j => { fst := types j, snd := v j }))
                    (And
                      (Eq D.frequent
                        (List.map types
                          (List.filter (fun j => Decidable.decide (instLENat.le t (v j))) (List.finRange n))))
                      (And
                        (instLENat.le D.windowGraph.size (instHMul.hMul M.card (instHPow.hPow (instHAdd.hAdd d 1) R)))
                        (And
                          (Exists fun y =>
                            And (Lax977378.RecordTests.Window D.windowGraph G R D.marked y)
                              (And (Eq (Finset.image y D.marked) M)
                                (Eq (Finset.image y D.rare) (Lax977378.CountParameters.rareSet types r G v t))))
                          (And (Lax977378.RecordTests.Passes D G)
                            (Exists fun f =>
                              And (Lax977378.Logic.Plain List.nil f)
                                (And (Lax977378.Logic.Unordered G f)
                                  (∀ (B : Lax977378.Logic.Graph c),
                                    Iff (Lax977378.Logic.Unordered B f) (Lax977378.RecordTests.Passes D B)))))))))))

concepts.description:

The whole unordered part of the record ranges over a single finite list.
The same sentence assigned to an entry tests it on every graph.

import Lax977378.Extraction

/-!
---
title: A uniform finite list of count and window tests
type: lemma
---
Fix the vocabulary, both radii, count cap, catalogue and window size bound.
The whole unordered part of the record ranges over a single finite list.
The same sentence assigned to an entry tests it on every graph.

namespace Lax977378.FiniteTests
open Lax977378.Logic Lax977378.RecordTests

axiom finiteTests {c n} (types : Fin n → Pointed c) (r R cap U : Nat) :
    ∃ tests : List (TestData c × Formula c),
      (∀ e ∈ tests, Plain [] e.2 ∧ ∀ G, Unordered G e.2 ↔ Passes e.1 G) ∧
      ∀ D : TestData c, D.radius = r → D.windowRadius = R → D.cap = cap →
        D.windowGraph.size ≤ U → ∀ (v : Fin n → Fin (cap+1)) (t : Nat),
        D.counts = List.ofFn (fun j => (types j,(v j).val)) →
        D.frequent = ((List.finRange n).filter (fun j => t ≤ (v j).val)).map types →
        ∃ f, (D,f) ∈ tests

end Lax977378.FiniteTests

      (∀ (D : Lax977378.RecordTests.TestData c),
        Eq D.radius r →
          Eq D.windowRadius R →
            Eq D.cap cap →

type: lemma

compares root data, reads endpoint roles on the inspected ball, and invokes

matching data supplies the whole recursive comparison, with consistent names.

namespace Lax977378.LocalCalls
open Lax977378.Logic Lax977378.OuterContexts Lax977378.RecordTests Lax977378.TagSafety

def Calls {c} (A B : Graph c)
    (root ends : Nat → Fin A.size → Fin B.size → Prop) :
    Nat → Fin A.size → Fin B.size → Prop
  | 0,x,y => root 0 x y
  | i+1,x,y => root (i+1) x y ∧ ∃ h : Ball A (i+1) x ≃ Ball B (i+1) y,
    (∀ v, v.val = x ↔ (h v).val = y) ∧
    (∀ v w, A.edge v.val w.val ↔ B.edge (h v).val (h w).val) ∧
    ∀ v, ends (i+1) v.val (h v).val ∧ Calls A B root ends i v.val (h v).val

axiom commonCalls {c} (W A B : Graph c) (mark : Finset (Fin W.size))
    (y : Fin W.size → Fin A.size) (z : Fin W.size → Fin B.size)
    (root ends : Nat → Fin A.size → Fin B.size → Prop) (i s : Nat)
    (wy : Window W A (s+radius i) mark y) (wz : Window W B (s+radius i) mark z)
    (data : ∀ j ≤ i, ∀ u, root j (y u) (z u) ∧ ends j (y u) (z u))
    (u : Fin W.size) (near : ∃ m ∈ mark, within W s m u) :
    Calls A B root ends i (y u) (z u)

axiom innerCalls {c} (W A B : Graph c) (mark : Finset (Fin W.size))
    (y : Fin W.size → Fin A.size) (z : Fin W.size → Fin B.size)
    (root ends : Nat → Fin A.size → Fin B.size → Prop) (i s slack : Nat)
    (wy : Window W A (s+radius i+slack) mark y) (wz : Window W B (s+radius i+slack) mark z)
    (data : ∀ j ≤ i, ∀ u, (∃ m ∈ mark, within W (s+radius i) m u) →
      root j (y u) (z u) ∧ ends j (y u) (z u))
    (u : Fin W.size) (near : ∃ m ∈ mark, within W s m u) :
    Calls A B root ends i (y u) (z u)

end Lax977378.LocalCalls

axiom coverCalls {c q K slack} (W A B : Graph c) (mark : Finset (Fin W.size))
    (y : Fin W.size → Fin A.size) (z : Fin W.size → Fin B.size)
    (wy : Window W A (radius K+slack) mark y) (wz : Window W B (radius K+slack) mark z)
    (X E : Nat → Finset (Fin A.size)) (Y F : Nat → Finset (Fin B.size))
    (covA : Covers A K X E) (covB : Covers B K Y F)
    (markA : mark.image y = X K) (markB : mark.image z = Y K)
    (a : Fin A.size → Fin q) (b : Fin B.size → Fin q)
    (root ends : Nat → Fin A.size → Fin B.size → Prop)
    (inside : ∀ i ≤ K, ∀ u, (∃ m ∈ mark, within W (radius K) m u) →
      root i (y u) (z u) ∧ ends i (y u) (z u))
    (ordinary : ∀ i ≤ K, ∀ x ∉ X i, ∀ w ∉ Y i,
      a x = b w ∧ (∀ p, A.pred p x ↔ B.pred p w) → root i x w)
    (interior : ∀ i < K, ∀ x ∉ E (i+1), ∀ w ∉ F (i+1), ends (i+1) x w)
    (seeds : List (Request c q))
    (typesA : ∀ x ∉ X K, ∃ s ∈ seeds, Realised s A (radius K) a x)
    (typesB : ∀ w ∉ Y K, ∃ s ∈ seeds, Realised s B (radius K) b w)
    (copiesA : ∀ s ∈ seeds, ∃ x ∉ X K, Realised s A (radius K) a x)
    (copiesB : ∀ s ∈ seeds, ∃ w ∉ Y K, Realised s B (radius K) b w) :
    (∀ x, ∃ w, Calls A B root ends K x w) ∧ (∀ w, ∃ x, Calls A B root ends K x w)

end Lax977378.LocalCover

axiom names {c K} (A : Graph c) (a : LinearOrder (Fin A.size)) (n : Nat → Nat)
    (P : (j : Nat) → @Partition (Fin A.size) (Fin (n j)) a inferInstance)
    (ra ea : Nat → Fin A.size → Nat)
    (base : ∀ x y, ra 0 x = ra 0 y → (P 0).block x = (P 0).block y)
    (child : ∀ j < K, ∀ x y, ra (j+1) x = ra (j+1) y →
      (P j).block x = (P j).block y → same A A a a (j+1) x y →
      (P (j+1)).block x = (P (j+1)).block y)
    (hom : ∀ j < K, ∀ x y, (P j).block x = (P j).block y → same A A a a j x y)
    (separated : ∀ j < K, ∀ x, Function.Injective (fun v : Ball A (j+1) x => (P j).block v.val))
    (roles : ∀ j < K, ∀ x y, ea (j+1) x = ea (j+1) y →
      (x = (P j).first ((P j).block x) ↔ y = (P j).first ((P j).block y)) ∧
      (x = (P j).last ((P j).block x) ↔ y = (P j).last ((P j).block y))) :
    ∀ j ≤ K, ∀ x y, agrees A A ra ea ra ea j x y → (P j).block x = (P j).block y

concepts.title: Finite coloured graphs and the cluster fragment
concepts.description:
Vertices are numbered solely to present a finite domain. Formulas have no access
to vertex numbers. Each unary predicate is interpreted independently. The
auxiliary order is an arbitrary linear order on the domain.

A variable is a word of child indices together with a continuation index.
The constructors of Legal express precisely the variable restrictions in the
graph vocabulary of the thesis. Greater-than is expressed by swapping the
arguments of less-than. Disjunction, negation and existential quantification
give the other Boolean connectives and universal quantification.
concepts.sourceText:
import Mathlib.Data.Fintype.Card
import Mathlib.Order.Basic

/-!
---
title: Finite coloured graphs and the cluster fragment
type: definition
---
Vertices are numbered solely to present a finite domain. Formulas have no access
to vertex numbers. Each unary predicate is interpreted independently. The
auxiliary order is an arbitrary linear order on the domain.

A variable is a word of child indices together with a continuation index.
The constructors of Legal express precisely the variable restrictions in the
graph vocabulary of the thesis. Greater-than is expressed by swapping the
arguments of less-than. Disjunction, negation and existential quantification
give the other Boolean connectives and universal quantification.
-/
namespace Lax977378.Logic

structure Graph (c : Nat) where
  size : Nat
  edge : Fin size → Fin size → Prop
  symm : ∀ x y, edge x y → edge y x
  loopless : ∀ x, ¬ edge x x
  pred : Fin c → Fin size → Prop

def Graph.Bounded {c : Nat} (G : Graph c) (d : Nat) : Prop :=
  ∀ x, ∃ neighbours : List (Fin G.size), neighbours.Nodup ∧
    neighbours.length ≤ d ∧ ∀ y, y ∈ neighbours ↔ G.edge x y

abbrev Var := List Nat × Nat

inductive Formula (c : Nat)
  | pred (p : Fin c) (x : Var)
  | edge (x y : Var)
  | eq (x y : Var)
  | lt (x y : Var)
  | neg (f : Formula c)
  | disj (f g : Formula c)
  | ex (x : Var) (f : Formula c)

def conj {c : Nat} (f g : Formula c) : Formula c :=
  .neg (.disj (.neg f) (.neg g))

def root : Var := ([], 0)

def child (w : List Nat) (a : Nat) : Var := (w ++ [a], 0)

def comparable (x y : Var) : Prop :=
  x.1 = y.1 ∨ (∃ a, x = child y.1 a) ∨ (∃ a, y = child x.1 a)

inductive Legal {c : Nat} : List Var → Formula c → Prop
  | pred {S x p} : x ∈ S → Legal S (.pred p x)
  | edge {S x y} : x ∈ S → y ∈ S → x.1 = y.1 → Legal S (.edge x y)
  | eq {S x y} : x ∈ S → y ∈ S → comparable x y → Legal S (.eq x y)
  | lt {S x y} : x ∈ S → y ∈ S → comparable x y → Legal S (.lt x y)
  | neg {S f} : Legal S f → Legal S (.neg f)
  | disj {S f g} : Legal S f → Legal S g → Legal S (.disj f g)
  | rootEx {f} : Legal [root] f → Legal [] (.ex root f)
  | childEx {S w a f} : (w, 0) ∈ S → child w a ∉ S →
      Legal (child w a :: S) f → Legal S (.ex (child w a) f)
  | continuation {S w i j f} : (w, j) ∈ S → j < i → (w, i) ∉ S →
      (∀ l < i, (w, l) ∈ S) → Legal ((w, i) :: S) f →
      Legal S (.ex (w, i) (conj (.edge (w, i) (w, j)) f))

def Plain {c : Nat} (S : List Var) : Formula c → Prop
  | .pred _ x => x ∈ S
  | .edge x y | .eq x y => x ∈ S ∧ y ∈ S
  | .lt _ _ => False
  | .neg f => Plain S f
  | .disj f g => Plain S f ∧ Plain S g
  | .ex x f => Plain (x :: S) f

def rank {c : Nat} : Formula c → Nat
  | .neg f => rank f
  | .disj f g => max (rank f) (rank g)
  | .ex _ f => rank f + 1
  | _ => 0

def eval {c : Nat} (G : Graph c) (ord : LinearOrder (Fin G.size))
    (env : Var → Option (Fin G.size)) : Formula c → Prop
  | .pred p x => ∃ u, env x = some u ∧ G.pred p u
  | .edge x y => ∃ u v, env x = some u ∧ env y = some v ∧ G.edge u v
  | .eq x y => ∃ u, env x = some u ∧ env y = some u
  | .lt x y => ∃ u v, env x = some u ∧ env y = some v ∧ ord.lt u v
  | .neg f => ¬ eval G ord env f
  | .disj f g => eval G ord env f ∨ eval G ord env g
  | .ex x f => ∃ u, eval G ord (fun y => if y = x then some u else env y) f

def Holds {c : Nat} (G : Graph c) (ord : LinearOrder (Fin G.size))
    (f : Formula c) : Prop := eval G ord (fun _ => none) f

def Unordered {c : Nat} (G : Graph c) (f : Formula c) : Prop :=
  Holds G inferInstance f

def InvariantOn {c : Nat} (C : Graph c → Prop) (f : Formula c) : Prop :=
  ∀ G, C G → ∀ o₁ o₂, Holds G o₁ f ↔ Holds G o₂ f

end Lax977378.Logic

import Lax977378.OrdinaryCalls

/-!

title: Transporting the exceptional stages through a shared window
type: lemma
---

noncomputable def moved {c} {W A B : Graph c} (y : Fin W.size → Fin A.size)
    (z : Fin W.size → Fin B.size) (S : Finset (Fin A.size)) : Finset (Fin B.size) := by
  classical exact (Finset.univ.filter (fun j => y j ∈ S)).image z

axiom moveStages {c K R} (W A B : Graph c) (mark : Finset (Fin W.size))
    (y : Fin W.size → Fin A.size) (z : Fin W.size → Fin B.size)
    (wy : Window W A R mark y) (wz : Window W B R mark z)
    (X E : Nat → Finset (Fin A.size)) (covers : Covers A K X E)
    (named : ∀ j < K, X j ∪ E (j+1) ⊆ mark.image y)
    (size : ∀ j < K, radius (j+1) ≤ R) :
    Covers B K (fun j => moved y z (X j)) (fun j => moved y z (E j))

end Lax977378.MarkedSets

concepts.description:
Agreement of the untagged coloured inputs gives agreement of the tagged
calculations outside the exceptional regions. Only the endpoint roles read
at the current stage and the exceptional vertices read by lower calls matter.

import Lax977378.CallAgreement

/-!
---
title: The recursive calculation without tags at ordinary vertices
type: lemma
---
Agreement of the untagged coloured inputs gives agreement of the tagged
calculations outside the exceptional regions. Only the endpoint roles read
at the current stage and the exceptional vertices read by lower calls matter.
-/
namespace Lax977378.OrdinaryCalls
open Lax977378.Logic Lax977378.OuterContexts Lax977378.LocalCalls Lax977378.TagSafety

def Covers {c} (G : Graph c) (K : Nat) (X E : Nat → Finset (Fin G.size)) : Prop :=
  ∀ j < K, ∀ u ∈ X j ∪ E (j+1), ∀ x, within G (radius (j+1)) u x → x ∈ X (j+1)

axiom untagged {c K} (A B : Graph c) (X E : Nat → Finset (Fin A.size))

concepts.title: Agreement of outer contexts in two ordered graphs
concepts.description:
A pointed ball is taken in the graph metric. Agreement at rank $i+1$
requires a rooted ordered ball isomorphism, matching rank-$i$ labels on
ball vertices and matching sets of lower contexts in the internal gaps
and the two outer gaps. Strict comparisons against every ball vertex
specify the gap. Both directions of witness matching are required.
concepts.sourceText:
import Lax977378.Logic

/-!
---
title: Agreement of outer contexts in two ordered graphs
type: definition
---
A pointed ball is taken in the graph metric. Agreement at rank $i+1$
requires a rooted ordered ball isomorphism, matching rank-$i$ labels on
ball vertices and matching sets of lower contexts in the internal gaps
and the two outer gaps. Strict comparisons against every ball vertex
specify the gap. Both directions of witness matching are required.
-/
namespace Lax977378.OuterContexts

open Lax977378.Logic

def within {c : Nat} (G : Graph c) : Nat → Fin G.size → Fin G.size → Prop
  | 0, x, y => x = y
  | i+1, x, y => within G i x y ∨ ∃ z, within G i x z ∧ G.edge z y

abbrev Ball {c : Nat} (G : Graph c) (r : Nat) (x : Fin G.size) :=
  {y : Fin G.size // within G r x y}

def same {c : Nat} (A B : Graph c) (a : LinearOrder (Fin A.size))
    (b : LinearOrder (Fin B.size)) : Nat → Fin A.size → Fin B.size → Prop
  | 0, x, y => ∀ p, A.pred p x ↔ B.pred p y
  | i+1, x, y =>
    ∃ h : Ball A (i+1) x ≃ Ball B (i+1) y,
      (∀ u, u.val = x ↔ (h u).val = y) ∧
      (∀ u v, A.edge u.val v.val ↔ B.edge (h u).val (h v).val) ∧
      (∀ u v, a.lt u.val v.val ↔ b.lt (h u).val (h v).val) ∧
      (∀ u, same A B a b i u.val (h u).val) ∧
      let matched := fun (z : Fin A.size) (w : Fin B.size) =>
        same A B a b i z w ∧ ∀ u,
          (a.lt z u.val ↔ b.lt w (h u).val) ∧ (a.lt u.val z ↔ b.lt (h u).val w)
      (∀ z, ∃ w, matched z w) ∧ (∀ w, ∃ z, matched z w)

def spectrumAgrees {c : Nat} (A B : Graph c) (a : LinearOrder (Fin A.size))
    (b : LinearOrder (Fin B.size)) (i : Nat) : Prop :=
  (∀ x, ∃ y, same A B a b i x y) ∧ (∀ y, ∃ x, same A B a b i x y)

end Lax977378.OuterContexts

concepts.title: Prescribing coloured neighbourhoods outside the exceptional set
concepts.description:
Each entry in the request list prescribes an injective colouring of an
uncoloured rooted neighbourhood. Repetition prescribes multiplicity. Given
enough occurrences, one proper colouring of the graph power realises every
entry at a separated centre and extends the colouring on the excluded set.
concepts.sourceText:
import Lax977378.CountParameters

/-!
---
title: Prescribing coloured neighbourhoods outside the exceptional set
type: lemma
---
Each entry in the request list prescribes an injective colouring of an
uncoloured rooted neighbourhood. Repetition prescribes multiplicity. Given
enough occurrences, one proper colouring of the graph power realises every
entry at a separated centre and extends the colouring on the excluded set.
-/
namespace Lax977378.Planting
open Lax977378.Logic Lax977378.OuterContexts Lax977378.RecordTests Lax977378.CountParameters

structure Request (c q : Nat) where
  type : Pointed c
  paint : Fin type.pattern.size → Fin q
  inj : Function.Injective paint

def Realised {c q} (s : Request c q) (G : Graph c) (r : Nat) (k : Fin G.size → Fin q)
    (x : Fin G.size) : Prop :=
  ∃ y, Window s.type.pattern G r {s.type.center} y ∧ y s.type.center = x ∧
    ∀ i, k (y i) = s.paint i

def ProperOn {c q} (G : Graph c) (p : Nat) (P : Finset (Fin G.size))
    (k : Fin G.size → Fin q) : Prop :=
  ∀ u ∈ P, ∀ v ∈ P, u ≠ v → within G p u v → k u ≠ k v

axiom plant {c d q : Nat} (G : Graph c) (hd : G.Bounded d) (r p : Nat)
    (palette : (d+1)^p ≤ q) (P : Finset (Fin G.size)) (colour : Fin G.size → Fin q)
    (proper : ProperOn G p P colour) (requests : List (Request c q))
    (enough : ∀ s ∈ requests, (P.card + requests.length * (d+1)^r) * (d+1)^(2*r+p) <
      (locations s.type r G).card) :
    ∃ k : Fin G.size → Fin q, ∃ centres : List (Fin G.size),
      (∀ u ∈ P, k u = colour u) ∧ ProperOn G p Finset.univ k ∧
      List.Forall₂ (fun x s => Realised s G r k x) centres requests ∧
      (∀ x ∈ centres, ∀ u ∈ P, ¬ within G (2*r+p) u x) ∧
      centres.Pairwise (fun x y => ¬ within G (2*r+p) x y)

end Lax977378.Planting

  G.Bounded d →
    ∀ (r p : Nat),
      instLENat.le (instHPow.hPow (instHAdd.hAdd d 1) p) q →
        ∀ (P : Finset (Fin G.size)) (colour : Fin G.size → Fin q),
          Lax977378.Planting.ProperOn G p P colour →
            ∀ (requests : List (Lax977378.Planting.Request c q)),
              (∀ (s : Lax977378.Planting.Request c q),
                  List.instMembership.mem requests s →
                    instLTNat.lt
                      (instHMul.hMul
                        (instHAdd.hAdd P.card (instHMul.hMul requests.length (instHPow.hPow (instHAdd.hAdd d 1) r)))
                        (instHPow.hPow (instHAdd.hAdd d 1) (instHAdd.hAdd (instHMul.hMul 2 r) p)))
                      (Lax977378.CountParameters.locations s.type r G).card) →
                Exists fun k =>
                  Exists fun centres =>
                    And (∀ (u : Fin G.size), SetLike.instMembership.mem P u → Eq (k u) (colour u))
                      (And (Lax977378.Planting.ProperOn G p Finset.univ k)
                        (And (List.Forall₂ (fun x s => Lax977378.Planting.Realised s G r k x) centres requests)
                          (And
                            (∀ (x : Fin G.size),
                              List.instMembership.mem centres x →
                                ∀ (u : Fin G.size),
                                  SetLike.instMembership.mem P u →
                                    Not (Lax977378.OuterContexts.within G (instHAdd.hAdd (instHMul.hMul 2 r) p) u x))
                            (List.Pairwise
                              (fun x y =>
                                Not (Lax977378.OuterContexts.within G (instHAdd.hAdd (instHMul.hMul 2 r) p) x y))
                              centres))))

concepts.title: Unordered neighbourhood and exceptional-window tests
concepts.description:
A diagram enumerates a finite induced graph with its original unary predicates.
The window condition says exactly which vertices are within a fixed radius
of one of the marked vertices. A pointed type is a one-centre window with
a distinguished root. A finite record can prescribe truncated type counts
and require its distinguished rare vertices to be precisely those outside
its list of frequent types, using the very same witnesses as its window.
concepts.sourceText:
import Lax977378.OuterContexts

/-!
---
title: Unordered neighbourhood and exceptional-window tests
type: lemma
---
A diagram enumerates a finite induced graph with its original unary predicates.
The window condition says exactly which vertices are within a fixed radius
of one of the marked vertices. A pointed type is a one-centre window with
a distinguished root. A finite record can prescribe truncated type counts
and require its distinguished rare vertices to be precisely those outside
its list of frequent types, using the very same witnesses as its window.
-/
namespace Lax977378.RecordTests
open Lax977378.Logic Lax977378.OuterContexts

def Diagram {c : Nat} (W G : Graph c) (y : Fin W.size → Fin G.size) : Prop :=
  Function.Injective y ∧ (∀ i j, W.edge i j ↔ G.edge (y i) (y j)) ∧
    ∀ p i, W.pred p i ↔ G.pred p (y i)

def Window {c : Nat} (W G : Graph c) (r : Nat) (marked : Finset (Fin W.size))
    (y : Fin W.size → Fin G.size) : Prop :=
  Diagram W G y ∧ ∀ x, (∃ i, y i = x) ↔ ∃ i ∈ marked, within G r (y i) x

structure Pointed (c : Nat) where
  pattern : Graph c
  center : Fin pattern.size

def Occurs {c : Nat} (t : Pointed c) (r : Nat) (G : Graph c) (x : Fin G.size) : Prop :=
  ∃ y, Window t.pattern G r {t.center} y ∧ y t.center = x

def AtLeast {c : Nat} (t : Pointed c) (r k : Nat) (G : Graph c) : Prop :=
  ∃ xs : Fin k → Fin G.size, Function.Injective xs ∧ ∀ i, Occurs t r G (xs i)

structure TestData (c : Nat) where
  radius : Nat
  windowRadius : Nat
  windowGraph : Graph c
  marked : Finset (Fin windowGraph.size)
  rare : Finset (Fin windowGraph.size)
  cap : Nat
  counts : List (Pointed c × Nat)
  frequent : List (Pointed c)

def Passes {c : Nat} (D : TestData c) (G : Graph c) : Prop :=
  (∀ tv ∈ D.counts, tv.2 ≤ D.cap ∧ AtLeast tv.1 D.radius tv.2 G ∧
    (tv.2 < D.cap → ¬ AtLeast tv.1 D.radius (tv.2+1) G)) ∧
  ∃ y, Window D.windowGraph G D.windowRadius D.marked y ∧
    ∀ x, (∃ i ∈ D.rare, y i = x) ↔ ¬ ∃ t ∈ D.frequent, Occurs t D.radius G x

axiom recordTest {c : Nat} (D : TestData c) :
  ∃ f : Formula c, Plain [] f ∧ ∀ G, Unordered G f ↔ Passes D G

end Lax977378.RecordTests

concepts.description:
Suppose two ordered partitions have the same ordered block names and that
vertices in matching blocks agree at the preceding rank. An isomorphism of
rooted balls preserving edges, block names and the first and last roles then
preserves the next outer context. Distinct ball vertices must occupy distinct
blocks. The graphs and the cardinalities of their blocks may differ.

import Lax977378.Blocks

title: One level of outer-context evaluation using the previous block table
type: lemma
---
Suppose two ordered partitions have the same ordered block names and that
vertices in matching blocks agree at the preceding rank. An isomorphism of
rooted balls preserving edges, block names and the first and last roles then
preserves the next outer context. Distinct ball vertices must occupy distinct
blocks. The graphs and the cardinalities of their blocks may differ.

open Lax977378.Logic Lax977378.Blocks Lax977378.OuterContexts

axiom levelStep {c n i : Nat} (A B : Graph c)
    (a : LinearOrder (Fin A.size)) (b : LinearOrder (Fin B.size))
    (P : @Partition (Fin A.size) (Fin n) a inferInstance)
    (Q : @Partition (Fin B.size) (Fin n) b inferInstance)
    (lower : ∀ x y, P.block x = Q.block y → same A B a b i x y)
    (x : Fin A.size) (y : Fin B.size) (h : Ball A (i+1) x ≃ Ball B (i+1) y)
    (center : ∀ u, u.val = x ↔ (h u).val = y)
    (edges : ∀ u v, A.edge u.val v.val ↔ B.edge (h u).val (h v).val)
    (unique : Function.Injective (fun u : Ball A (i+1) x => P.block u.val))
    (blocks : ∀ u, P.block u.val = Q.block (h u).val)
    (first : ∀ u, u.val = P.first (P.block u.val) ↔ (h u).val = Q.first (Q.block (h u).val))
    (last : ∀ u, u.val = P.last (P.block u.val) ↔ (h u).val = Q.last (Q.block (h u).val)) :
    same A B a b (i+1) x y

end Lax977378.Refinement

            (∀ (u : Lax977378.OuterContexts.Ball A (instHAdd.hAdd i 1) x),
                Eq (P.block u.val) (Q.block (EquivLike.toFunLike.coe h u).val)) →
              (∀ (u : Lax977378.OuterContexts.Ball A (instHAdd.hAdd i 1) x),

                    (Eq (EquivLike.toFunLike.coe h u).val (Q.first (Q.block (EquivLike.toFunLike.coe h u).val)))) →
                (∀ (u : Lax977378.OuterContexts.Ball A (instHAdd.hAdd i 1) x),

concepts.description:
A finite list pairs the unordered data with the set of labels in the final
table. Replay on each individual passing graph supplies a compatible order.
The resulting orders satisfy the pairwise form of the record theorem.

type: lemma
---

The resulting orders satisfy the pairwise form of the record theorem.

    LinearOrder (Fin G.size) → Fin G.size → Fin N)
    (sound : ∀ A B ha hb a b x y, lab A ha a x = lab B hb b y → same A B a b K x y)

concepts.description:
The exceptional vertices correspond through the named window. Outside it,
each coloured type occurs on both graphs and determines its source child
block. Choose one source representative per ordinary type. The target then
hits every source child block, including every named singleton, without

/-!
---
title: Representatives of all child blocks on a passing graph
type: lemma
---
The exceptional vertices correspond through the named window. Outside it,
each coloured type occurs on both graphs and determines its source child
block. Choose one source representative per ordinary type. The target then
hits every source child block, including every named singleton, without
requiring a bijection of ordinary vertices.
-/
namespace Lax977378.Representatives

axiom representatives {A B T I : Type} (X : Set A) (Y : Set B)
    (exceptional : Y ≃ X) (shapeA : A → T) (shapeB : B → T) (block : A → I)
    (onto : Function.Surjective block)
    (availableA : ∀ y, y ∉ Y → ∃ x ∉ X, shapeA x = shapeB y)
    (availableB : ∀ x, x ∉ X → ∃ y ∉ Y, shapeB y = shapeA x)
    (constant : ∀ x ∉ X, ∀ u ∉ X, shapeA x = shapeA u → block x = block u) :
    ∃ rep : B → A, (∀ y : Y, rep y = (exceptional y).val) ∧
      (∀ y ∉ Y, rep y ∉ X ∧ shapeA (rep y) = shapeB y) ∧
      (∀ x : X, ∃! y, rep y = x.val) ∧ Function.Surjective (block ∘ rep)

end Lax977378.Representatives

  Function.Surjective block →
    (∀ (y : B),
        Not (Set.instMembership.mem Y y) →
          Exists fun x => And (Not (Set.instMembership.mem X x)) (Eq (shapeA x) (shapeB y))) →
      (∀ (x : A),
          Not (Set.instMembership.mem X x) →
            Exists fun y => And (Not (Set.instMembership.mem Y y)) (Eq (shapeB y) (shapeA x))) →
        (∀ (x : A),
            Not (Set.instMembership.mem X x) →
              ∀ (u : A), Not (Set.instMembership.mem X u) → Eq (shapeA x) (shapeA u) → Eq (block x) (block u)) →
          Exists fun rep =>
            And (∀ (y : Y.Elem), Eq (rep y.val) (EquivLike.toFunLike.coe exceptional y).val)
              (And
                (∀ (y : B),
                  Not (Set.instMembership.mem Y y) →
                    And (Not (Set.instMembership.mem X (rep y))) (Eq (shapeA (rep y)) (shapeB y)))
                (And (∀ (x : X.Elem), ExistsUnique fun y => Eq (rep y) x.val)
                  (Function.Surjective (Function.comp block rep))))

import Lax977378.Transport
import Lax977378.CallAgreement

/-!
---
title: Replaying every level from matching recursive local data
type: lemma
---
Source partitions refer to a single final source order. Each target vertex
has a full-rank representative. Lower-rank calls at a target ball vertex need
not use its chosen representative; comparing the two source calls recovers
the same lower block. Thus one representative map works at all levels.

namespace Lax977378.RunReplay
open Lax977378.Logic Lax977378.Blocks Lax977378.OuterContexts Lax977378.Stage
open Lax977378.CallAgreement

axiom runReplay {c d K} (A B : Graph c) (ha : A.Bounded d) (hb : B.Bounded d)
    (a : LinearOrder (Fin A.size)) (n : Nat → Nat)
    (P : (j : Nat) → @Partition (Fin A.size) (Fin (n j)) a inferInstance)
    (ra ea : Nat → Fin A.size → Nat) (rb eb : Nat → Fin B.size → Nat)
    (rep : Fin B.size → Fin A.size)
    (matched : ∀ z, agrees A B ra ea rb eb K (rep z) z)
    (hit : ∀ j ≤ K, Function.Surjective ((P j).block ∘ rep))
    (base : ∀ x z, (P 0).block x = (P 0).block (rep z) → ∀ p, A.pred p x ↔ B.pred p z)
    (names : ∀ j ≤ K, ∀ x y, agrees A A ra ea ra ea j x y → (P j).block x = (P j).block y)
    (hom : ∀ j ≤ K, ∀ x y, (P j).block x = (P j).block y → same A A a a j x y)
    (parent : ∀ j < K, ∀ x y, (P (j+1)).block x = (P (j+1)).block y → (P j).block x = (P j).block y)
    (ends : ∀ j < K, ∀ t, ∀ e ∈ [(P j).first t,(P j).last t],
      (∀ x, (P (j+1)).block x = (P (j+1)).block e → x = e) ∧ ∃! z, rep z = e)
    (separated : ∀ j < K, ∀ x, Function.Injective (fun v : Ball A (j+1) x => (P j).block v.val))
    (roles : ∀ j < K, ∀ x z, ea (j+1) x = eb (j+1) z →
      (x = (P j).first ((P j).block x) ↔ rep z = (P j).first ((P j).block (rep z))) ∧
      (x = (P j).last ((P j).block x) ↔ rep z = (P j).last ((P j).block (rep z)))) :
    ∀ j ≤ K, ∀ (b : LinearOrder (Fin B.size)), Compatible b ((P j).block ∘ rep) →
      (∀ x z, (P j).block x = (P j).block (rep z) → same A B a b j x z) ∧
      spectrumAgrees A B a b j

end Lax977378.RunReplay

concepts.description:
The separation statement allows repeated requests for the same neighbourhood
type. The forbidden set initially includes the excluded region and after each
choice includes the entire forbidden ball around the chosen centre.

A symmetric list of neighbours describes the graph power. A partial proper

import Mathlib.Data.Finset.Card
import Mathlib.Data.Fintype.Basic

/-!
---
title: Simultaneous separated choices and extension of a partial colouring
type: lemma
---
The separation statement allows repeated requests for the same neighbourhood
type. The forbidden set initially includes the excluded region and after each
choice includes the entire forbidden ball around the chosen centre.

A symmetric list of neighbours describes the graph power. A partial proper
colouring extends with a palette larger than every list of neighbours.
-/
namespace Lax977378.Separation

axiom separated {V : Type} [DecidableEq V] (halo : V → Finset V)
    (H : Nat) (bound : ∀ x, (halo x).card ≤ H)
    (requests : List (Finset V)) (excluded : Finset V)
    (enough : ∀ s ∈ requests, excluded.card + requests.length * H < s.card) :
    ∃ centres : List V, List.Forall₂ (fun x s => x ∈ s) centres requests ∧
      (∀ x ∈ centres, x ∉ excluded) ∧ centres.Pairwise (fun x y => y ∉ halo x)

axiom extendColouring {V : Type} [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V] (nb : V → Finset V)
    (symm : ∀ x y, x ∈ nb y → y ∈ nb x) (loopless : ∀ x, x ∉ nb x)
    (q : Nat) (bound : ∀ x, (nb x).card < q) (P : Finset V) (colour : V → Fin q)
    (proper : ∀ x ∈ P, ∀ y ∈ P, y ∈ nb x → colour x ≠ colour y) :
    ∃ κ : V → Fin q, (∀ x ∈ P, κ x = colour x) ∧ ∀ x y, y ∈ nb x → κ x ≠ κ y

end Lax977378.Separation

  (∀ (x y : V), SetLike.instMembership.mem (nb y) x → SetLike.instMembership.mem (nb x) y) →
    (∀ (x : V), Not (SetLike.instMembership.mem (nb x) x)) →
      ∀ (q : Nat),
        (∀ (x : V), instLTNat.lt (nb x).card q) →
          ∀ (P : Finset V) (colour : V → Fin q),
            (∀ (x : V),
                SetLike.instMembership.mem P x →
                  ∀ (y : V),
                    SetLike.instMembership.mem P y → SetLike.instMembership.mem (nb x) y → Ne (colour x) (colour y)) →
              Exists fun κ =>
                And (∀ (x : V), SetLike.instMembership.mem P x → Eq (κ x) (colour x))
                  (∀ (x y : V), SetLike.instMembership.mem (nb x) y → Ne (κ x) (κ y))

separated : ∀ {V : Type} [DecidableEq V] (halo : V → Finset V) (H : Nat),
  (∀ (x : V), instLENat.le (halo x).card H) →
    ∀ (requests : List (Finset V)) (excluded : Finset V),
      (∀ (s : Finset V),
          List.instMembership.mem requests s →
            instLTNat.lt (instHAdd.hAdd excluded.card (instHMul.hMul requests.length H)) s.card) →
        Exists fun centres =>
          And (List.Forall₂ (fun x s => SetLike.instMembership.mem s x) centres requests)
            (And (∀ (x : V), List.instMembership.mem centres x → Not (SetLike.instMembership.mem excluded x))
              (List.Pairwise (fun x y => Not (SetLike.instMembership.mem (halo x) y)) centres))

concepts.description:
Given the threshold vector and a proper auxiliary colouring, produce all
source tables, their common order, and the unordered test of the actual
window around the final exceptional set. All size estimates are independent
of the source graph except through its initial number of rare vertices.

import Lax977378.SourceTables
import Lax977378.ColouredRun
import Lax977378.Extraction

/-!
---
title: A source graph yields its bounded record and final order
type: lemma
---
Given the threshold vector and a proper auxiliary colouring, produce all
source tables, their common order, and the unordered test of the actual
window around the final exceptional set. All size estimates are independent
of the source graph except through its initial number of rare vertices.
-/
namespace Lax977378.SourceRecord
open Lax977378.Logic Lax977378.SourceTables Lax977378.SourceRun Lax977378.Planting
open Lax977378.RecordTests Lax977378.CountParameters

axiom sourceRecord (c d K : Nat) : ∃ N : Nat → Nat,
    ∀ (G : Graph c), G.Bounded d → ∀ (q : Nat) (κ : Fin G.size → Fin q),
    ProperOn G (K+K) Finset.univ κ →
    ∀ {n} (types : Fin n → Pointed c) (r R cap t : Nat) (v : Fin n → Nat),
    (∀ j, v j = min cap (locations (types j) r G).card) →
    let Z := rareSet types r G v t
    ∃ (a : LinearOrder (Fin G.size)) (T : Nat → Table G a) (D : TestData c),
      (T 0).exceptions = Z ∧
      (∀ x y, (T 0).part.block x = (T 0).part.block y ↔ x = y ∨
        x ∉ Z ∧ y ∉ Z ∧ κ x = κ y ∧ ∀ p, G.pred p x ↔ G.pred p y) ∧
      (∀ j < K, Follows j (T j) (T (j+1))) ∧
      (T K).exceptions.card ≤ limit d N (Z.card + 2^c*q) K ∧
      D.radius = r ∧ D.windowRadius = R ∧ D.cap = cap ∧
      D.counts = List.ofFn (fun j => (types j,v j)) ∧
      D.frequent = ((List.finRange n).filter (fun j => t ≤ v j)).map types ∧
      D.windowGraph.size ≤ limit d N (Z.card + 2^c*q) K * (d+1)^R ∧
      (∃ y, Window D.windowGraph G R D.marked y ∧
        D.marked.image y = (T K).exceptions ∧ D.rare.image y = Z) ∧ Passes D G

end Lax977378.SourceRecord

  Exists fun N =>
    ∀ (G : Lax977378.Logic.Graph c),
      G.Bounded d →
        ∀ (q : Nat) (κ : Fin G.size → Fin q),
          Lax977378.Planting.ProperOn G (instHAdd.hAdd K K) Finset.univ κ →
            ∀ {n : Nat} (types : Fin n → Lax977378.RecordTests.Pointed c) (r R cap t : Nat) (v : Fin n → Nat),
              (∀ (j : Fin n), Eq (v j) (instMinNat.min cap (Lax977378.CountParameters.locations (types j) r G).card)) →
                let Z := Lax977378.CountParameters.rareSet types r G v t;
                Exists fun a =>
                  Exists fun T =>
                    Exists fun D =>
                      And (Eq (T 0).exceptions Z)
                        (And
                          (∀ (x y : Fin G.size),
                            Iff (Eq ((T 0).part.block x) ((T 0).part.block y))
                              (Or (Eq x y)
                                (And (Not (SetLike.instMembership.mem Z x))
                                  (And (Not (SetLike.instMembership.mem Z y))
                                    (And (Eq (κ x) (κ y)) (∀ (p : Fin c), Iff (G.pred p x) (G.pred p y)))))))
                          (And
                            (∀ (j : Nat),
                              instLTNat.lt j K → Lax977378.SourceTables.Follows j (T j) (T (instHAdd.hAdd j 1)))
                            (And
                              (instLENat.le (T K).exceptions.card
                                (Lax977378.SourceRun.limit d N
                                  (instHAdd.hAdd Z.card (instHMul.hMul (instHPow.hPow 2 c) q)) K))
                              (And (Eq D.radius r)
                                (And (Eq D.windowRadius R)
                                  (And (Eq D.cap cap)
                                    (And (Eq D.counts (List.ofFn fun j => { fst := types j, snd := v j }))
                                      (And
                                        (Eq D.frequent
                                          (List.map types
                                            (List.filter (fun j => Decidable.decide (instLENat.le t (v j)))
                                              (List.finRange n))))
                                        (And
                                          (instLENat.le D.windowGraph.size
                                            (instHMul.hMul
                                              (Lax977378.SourceRun.limit d N
                                                (instHAdd.hAdd Z.card (instHMul.hMul (instHPow.hPow 2 c) q)) K)
                                              (instHPow.hPow (instHAdd.hAdd d 1) R)))
                                          (And
                                            (Exists fun y =>
                                              And (Lax977378.RecordTests.Window D.windowGraph G R D.marked y)
                                                (And (Eq (Finset.image y D.marked) (T K).exceptions)
                                                  (Eq (Finset.image y D.rare) Z)))
                                            (Lax977378.RecordTests.Passes D G)))))))))))

concepts.title: Constructing the bounded history of the source partitions
concepts.description:
Starting with a stable partition separating every inspected ball, retain each
parent partition, its endpoints, and the rule defining its children. At each
stage the exceptional set is exactly the neighbourhood of the previous
exceptions and the new endpoints. A common bound for the number of rows and
exceptions depends only on the parameters and the initial bound.
concepts.sourceText:
import Lax977378.Stage
import Lax977378.TagSafety

/-!
---
title: Constructing the bounded history of the source partitions
type: lemma
---
Starting with a stable partition separating every inspected ball, retain each
parent partition, its endpoints, and the rule defining its children. At each
stage the exceptional set is exactly the neighbourhood of the previous
exceptions and the new endpoints. A common bound for the number of rows and
exceptions depends only on the parameters and the initial bound.
-/
namespace Lax977378.SourceRun
open Lax977378.Logic Lax977378.OuterContexts Lax977378.Blocks Lax977378.Stage Lax977378.TagSafety

structure Layer {c : Nat} (G : Graph c) where
  n : Nat
  row : Fin G.size → Fin n
  exceptions : Finset (Fin G.size)

def History {c} (G : Graph c) (initial : Layer G) : Nat → Layer G → Prop
  | 0, L => L = initial
  | j+1, L => ∃ H : Layer G, History G initial j H ∧
    ∃ f l : Fin H.n → Fin G.size,
      (∀ x, x ∈ L.exceptions ↔ ∃ z, (z ∈ H.exceptions ∨ (∃ t, f t = z) ∨ ∃ t, l t = z) ∧
        within G (radius (j+1)) z x) ∧
      (∀ (a : LinearOrder (Fin G.size)), Compatible a L.row →
        ∃ P : @Partition (Fin G.size) (Fin H.n) a inferInstance,
          P.block = H.row ∧ P.first = f ∧ P.last = l) ∧
      (∀ (a : LinearOrder (Fin G.size)), Compatible a L.row → ∀ x y,
        L.row x = L.row y ↔ H.row x = H.row y ∧
          (x = y ∨ x ∉ L.exceptions ∧ y ∉ L.exceptions ∧ same G G a a (j+1) x y))

def limit (d : Nat) (N : Nat → Nat) (b : Nat) : Nat → Nat
  | 0 => b
  | j+1 => (3*(d+1)^(radius (j+1)) + N j) * limit d N b j

axiom construct (c d K : Nat) : ∃ N : Nat → Nat, ∀ (G : Graph c), G.Bounded d →
    ∀ (initial : Layer G) (b : Nat), initial.n ≤ b → initial.exceptions.card ≤ b →
    Function.Surjective initial.row → Stable G 0 initial.row →
    (∀ x, Function.Injective (fun u : Ball G K x => initial.row u.val)) →
    ∃ L : Layer G, History G initial K L ∧ Stable G K L.row ∧
      Function.Surjective L.row ∧ L.n ≤ limit d N b K ∧ L.exceptions.card ≤ limit d N b K

end Lax977378.SourceRun

construct : ∀ (c d K : Nat),
  Exists fun N =>
    ∀ (G : Lax977378.Logic.Graph c),
      G.Bounded d →
        ∀ (initial : Lax977378.SourceRun.Layer G) (b : Nat),
          instLENat.le initial.n b →
            instLENat.le initial.exceptions.card b →
              Function.Surjective initial.row →
                Lax977378.Stage.Stable G 0 initial.row →
                  (∀ (x : Fin G.size), Function.Injective fun u => initial.row u.val) →
                    Exists fun L =>
                      And (Lax977378.SourceRun.History G initial K L)
                        (And (Lax977378.Stage.Stable G K L.row)
                          (And (Function.Surjective L.row)
                            (And (instLENat.le L.n (Lax977378.SourceRun.limit d N b K))
                              (instLENat.le L.exceptions.card (Lax977378.SourceRun.limit d N b K)))))

concepts.description:
A history retains the endpoint choices of each refinement. Reading it
backwards from a final table produces the earlier tables in that same order.
The two successive tables satisfy both the exception closure and the rule
identifying ordinary child blocks by parent and outer context.

import Lax977378.SourceRun

/-!
---
title: Reading all source tables in a single final order
type: lemma
---
A history retains the endpoint choices of each refinement. Reading it
backwards from a final table produces the earlier tables in that same order.
The two successive tables satisfy both the exception closure and the rule
identifying ordinary child blocks by parent and outer context.

namespace Lax977378.SourceTables
open Lax977378.Logic Lax977378.OuterContexts Lax977378.Blocks Lax977378.SourceRun Lax977378.TagSafety

structure Table {c} (G : Graph c) (a : LinearOrder (Fin G.size)) where
  n : Nat
  part : @Partition (Fin G.size) (Fin n) a inferInstance
  exceptions : Finset (Fin G.size)

def Table.layer {c G a} (T : @Table c G a) : Layer G := ⟨T.n,T.part.block,T.exceptions⟩

def Follows {c G a} (j : Nat) (P Q : @Table c G a) : Prop :=
  (∀ x, x ∈ Q.exceptions ↔ ∃ z, (z ∈ P.exceptions ∨ (∃ t, P.part.first t = z) ∨
    ∃ t, P.part.last t = z) ∧ within G (radius (j+1)) z x) ∧
  (∀ x y, Q.part.block x = Q.part.block y ↔ P.part.block x = P.part.block y ∧
    (x = y ∨ x ∉ Q.exceptions ∧ y ∉ Q.exceptions ∧ same G G a a (j+1) x y))

axiom sourceTables {c K} (G : Graph c) (I L : Layer G) (hist : History G I K L)
    (onto : Function.Surjective L.row) :
    ∃ (a : LinearOrder (Fin G.size)) (T : Nat → Table G a),
      (T 0).layer = I ∧ (T K).layer = L ∧ ∀ j < K, Follows j (T j) (T (j+1))

end Lax977378.SourceTables

concepts.title: Constructing a refinement and proving invariance under internal orders
concepts.description:
For one graph, take legal endpoints in every current block. Split each parent
into the first singleton, the other exceptional singletons, ordinary groups
by outer context, and the last singleton. Every order compatible with the
result has the prescribed endpoints in its parent blocks. Vertices in the
same new block agree at the next rank in any two such orders.
concepts.sourceText:
import Lax977378.Endpoints
import Lax977378.ContextLabels
import Lax977378.Refinement

/-!
---
title: Constructing a refinement and proving invariance under internal orders
type: lemma
---
For one graph, take legal endpoints in every current block. Split each parent
into the first singleton, the other exceptional singletons, ordinary groups
by outer context, and the last singleton. Every order compatible with the
result has the prescribed endpoints in its parent blocks. Vertices in the
same new block agree at the next rank in any two such orders.
-/
namespace Lax977378.Stage
open Lax977378.Logic Lax977378.OuterContexts Lax977378.Blocks

def Compatible {v n} (a : LinearOrder (Fin v)) (block : Fin v → Fin n) : Prop :=
  ∀ x y, a.le x y → block x ≤ block y

def Stable {c n} (G : Graph c) (i : Nat) (block : Fin G.size → Fin n) : Prop :=
  ∀ a b, Compatible a block → Compatible b block →
    ∀ x y, block x = block y → same G G a b i x y

axiom refineBlocks (c d i : Nat) : ∃ N : Nat, ∀ {n : Nat} (G : Graph c), G.Bounded d →
    ∀ (block : Fin G.size → Fin n) (first last : Fin n → Fin G.size),
    (∀ j, block (first j) = j) → (∀ j, block (last j) = j) →
    (∀ j, first j = last j → ∀ x, block x = j → x = first j) →
    ∀ (Γ : Finset (Fin G.size)), (∀ j, first j ∈ Γ ∧ last j ∈ Γ) →
    Stable G i block →
    (∀ x, Function.Injective (fun u : Ball G (i+1) x => block u.val)) →
    ∃ m : Nat, ∃ next : Fin G.size → Fin m, Function.Surjective next ∧
      m ≤ Γ.card + n * N ∧
      Stable G (i+1) next ∧
      (∀ (a : LinearOrder (Fin G.size)), Compatible a next →
        ∃ P : @Partition (Fin G.size) (Fin n) a inferInstance,
          P.block = block ∧ P.first = first ∧ P.last = last) ∧
      (∀ (a : LinearOrder (Fin G.size)), Compatible a next → ∀ x y,
        next x = next y ↔ block x = block y ∧
          (x = y ∨ x ∉ Γ ∧ y ∉ Γ ∧ same G G a a (i+1) x y))

end Lax977378.Stage

statements.signature:
refineBlocks : ∀ (c d i : Nat),
  Exists fun N =>
    ∀ {n : Nat} (G : Lax977378.Logic.Graph c),
      G.Bounded d →
        ∀ (block : Fin G.size → Fin n) (first last : Fin n → Fin G.size),
          (∀ (j : Fin n), Eq (block (first j)) j) →
            (∀ (j : Fin n), Eq (block (last j)) j) →
              (∀ (j : Fin n), Eq (first j) (last j) → ∀ (x : Fin G.size), Eq (block x) j → Eq x (first j)) →
                ∀ (Γ : Finset (Fin G.size)),
                  (∀ (j : Fin n),
                      And (SetLike.instMembership.mem Γ (first j)) (SetLike.instMembership.mem Γ (last j))) →
                    Lax977378.Stage.Stable G i block →
                      (∀ (x : Fin G.size), Function.Injective fun u => block u.val) →
                        Exists fun m =>
                          Exists fun next =>
                            And (Function.Surjective next)
                              (And (instLENat.le m (instHAdd.hAdd Γ.card (instHMul.hMul n N)))
                                (And (Lax977378.Stage.Stable G (instHAdd.hAdd i 1) next)

                                      Lax977378.Stage.Compatible a next →

                                    (∀ (a : LinearOrder (Fin G.size)),
                                      Lax977378.Stage.Compatible a next →
                                        ∀ (x y : Fin G.size),
                                          Iff (Eq (next x) (next y))

                                                (And (Not (SetLike.instMembership.mem Γ x))
                                                  (And (Not (SetLike.instMembership.mem Γ y))
                                                    (Lax977378.OuterContexts.same G G a a (instHAdd.hAdd i 1) x

concepts.title: Structural properties of the tables read from a source run
concepts.description:
The rows refine their parents, every endpoint is isolated at the next stage,
and all past exceptions have names in the final window. Separation on the
initial ball persists down the refinement. Row homogeneity holds in the
final order in which the tables were read.
concepts.sourceText:
import Lax977378.SourceRecord
import Lax977378.OrdinaryCalls

/-!
---
title: Structural properties of the tables read from a source run
type: lemma
---
The rows refine their parents, every endpoint is isolated at the next stage,
and all past exceptions have names in the final window. Separation on the
initial ball persists down the refinement. Row homogeneity holds in the
final order in which the tables were read.
-/
namespace Lax977378.TableFacts
open Lax977378.Logic Lax977378.OuterContexts Lax977378.SourceTables Lax977378.OrdinaryCalls

def endpoints {c G a} (T : @Table c G a) := Finset.univ.image T.part.first ∪ Finset.univ.image T.part.last

axiom facts {c d K} (A : Graph c) (hd : A.Bounded d) (a : LinearOrder (Fin A.size))
    (T : Nat → Table A a) (next : ∀ j < K, Follows j (T j) (T (j+1)))
    (base : ∀ x y, (T 0).part.block x = (T 0).part.block y → ∀ p, A.pred p x ↔ A.pred p y)
    (sep : ∀ x, Function.Injective (fun u : Ball A K x => (T 0).part.block u.val)) :
    (∀ i j, i ≤ j → j ≤ K → (T i).exceptions ⊆ (T j).exceptions) ∧
    (∀ j < K, endpoints (T j) ⊆ (T (j+1)).exceptions) ∧
    (∀ j ≤ K, ∀ x y, (T j).part.block x = (T j).part.block y → same A A a a j x y) ∧
    (∀ j < K, ∀ x, Function.Injective (fun u : Ball A (j+1) x => (T j).part.block u.val))

end Lax977378.TableFacts

concepts.title: Locality of the calculation without tags
concepts.description:
At stage i+1 the exceptional region contains the radius-ρ(i+1) balls
around the previous exceptional region and the newly chosen endpoints.
An ordinary root therefore sees no current endpoint on its inspected ball,
and each recursive call at a ball vertex sees no previous exceptional tag.
